title: Veno-arterial ECMO circuit

stages.name: Console
stages.action: Brackets unclamp and the pump head translates along the drive axis.

stages.name: Mag-lev pump
stages.action: Bearingless impeller drives venous blood out through the volute.

stages.name: Membrane lung
stages.action: Camera descends into the polymethylpentene hollow-fiber bundle.

stages.name: Fiber wall
stages.action: Oxygen diffuses in and carbon dioxide diffuses out across a schematic boundary.

stages.name: Full loop
stages.action: Pull out to cannula, mag-lev drive, gas blender, membrane lung, and heat exchanger.

limits: 10 μm is a schematic callout, not a measurement.
No flow, pressure, saturation, RPM, or temperature figures.
